children: Imports to New Zealand rose 13.1% year-on-year to NZD 8.0 billion in August 2026, following a 28.4% jump in the previous month.

The increase in imports was mainly driven by higher purchases of petroleum and petroleum products (up 43%), vehicles, parts, and accessories (up 30%), electrical machinery and equipment (up 25%), and mechanical machinery and equipment (up 15%).

title: New Zealand Imports Climbs 13% in August
